description: Flight Computer audio integration manifest derived from the supplied Cutlass audio package. Binary OGG assets are intentionally not included here; place them under the paths listed in this manifest before packaging.

takeoff.reason: Primary integrated takeoff recording. Replaces the previous takeoff/flight ambience path rather than layering another continuous engine loop beneath it.
takeoff.direction: Play from flight-system activation; hand off to the integrated flight loop at 22 seconds with a short crossfade.

flight_loop.reason: Primary integrated flight recording. It is the main continuous flight layer after the 22 second takeoff handoff.
flight_loop.direction: Loop after the takeoff handoff. Do not layer the former continuous engine loop beneath it.

ghost_2.reason: Additional ambient flight bed that remains active whenever stabiliser or autopilot flight control is active.
ghost_2.direction: Play alongside the primary integrated flight audio while stabiliser or autopilot is controlling the vessel. Scale gently with flight state; stop when both are inactive.

engine_secondary_effects.reason: Secondary reactions/effects. These may layer over the integrated flight audio only when their specific flight condition occurs.
engine_secondary_effects.direction: Do not use these as the continuous base flight loop.

cockpit_ui.reason: Short cockpit/UI feedback sounds with restrained volume.
cockpit_ui.direction: Remain positional/UI-specific and independent of the continuous flight ambience.

attenuation.reason: Keep the established Flight Computer ambience range so ship audio fades naturally at practical distance.
